polarity: merged ⊇ (base ∪ head), per configured file: an entry present on EITHER side must survive the merge. A merge that drops one side's entry is a silent data loss, so the gate is RED. This is deliberately NOT a shrink-only rule: deleting an entry can be legitimate (a retired module), but that decision belongs to the registry's own semantics and needs its own ruling, not a generic gate. Do NOT add further invariants here without a written ruling.

registries.note: One part of the exact physical inventory of daemon modules (NATIVE_ORIGINS is their union, merged in test_native_resident_tripwires.py; plus the explicitly named HISTORICAL_ROWS). Entries are added as modules are physically split; #1324 and #1297 lost entries by merging a stale copy of this constant.
